text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the amusement park with Wonder Acute
for a breather, but—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Good grief.
I honestly thought I wouldn't make it back in one piece~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ferris wheels never fail to be thrilling rides, do they?
choice_data_list: Are you not good with heights?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, more than that, I'm just not used to the scenery
moving along entirely against my own will...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer, but next time...
let's find something we can enjoy at a walking pace, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If we're talking about attractions you walk through rather than ride, maybe a haunted house or a mirror maze?
As I wondered if there weren't many options—"

text_block_list.name: Girl Fan
text_block_list.text: Wow, it's Acute-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Father
text_block_list.text: H-Hey! Talking to them out of the blue like that will only cause trouble, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Father
text_block_list.text: I apologize for coming up to you so suddenly! My daughter has been a huge fan of Wonder Acute for ages!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I don't mind at all~ Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hello there, little miss.
Are ya cheering for me?

text_block_list.name: Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You know, I love how
Accute-chan is always smiling!

text_block_list.name: Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Acute-chan!
Let's ride the roller coaster together!
I'm finally able to ride them now!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my, a roller coaster...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a wonderful invitation, but even the Ferris wheel seemed tough for Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I opened my mouth to decline on their behalf—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Alright~
Shall we head to the roller coaster, then?

text_block_list.name: Girl Fan
text_block_list.text: Yay, woohoo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WHOOSH—!!)

text_block_list.name: Girl and Acute
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaaah!!!
......

text_block_list.name: Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing, you were so fast!
Acute-chan, look at that giant boat over there too!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: A "buffet", is it? Sure, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (VROOM! VROOM!)

text_block_list.name: Girl and Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! We're dropping, we're dropping, so faaaast!!
......

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, Wonder Acute, who was supposed to be bad with rides,
kept smiling the whole time as she tagged along. And then――

text_block_list.name: Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh man... You really entertained me the whole time.
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Girl Fan
text_block_list.text:
You know, riding on all sorts of things together
felt just like running alongside you, Acute-chan!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad you had fun.
Be careful on your way home, okay?

text_block_list.name: Girl Fan
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Bye-bye, Acute-chan~!
choice_data_list: Good work, you gave it your all!
Good work, you gave it your all!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, I'm in trouble.
My face is somehow stuck like this..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, while forcing a smile for the girls,
her facial expression ended up freezing in place.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That girl told me she loved seeing me smiling, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And besides, happy childhood memories are supposed to support you during tough times, so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the little girl's sake, Wonder Acute rode
the attraction she wasn't good with, all with a smile.
choice_data_list: I'm sure it turned into a great memory!
I'm sure that became a wonderful memory!
...Shall we rest for a bit before heading back?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the little girl's sake, Wonder Acute rode
the attraction she wasn't good with, all with a smile.
choice_data_list: I'm sure it turned into a great memory!
I'm sure that became a wonderful memory!
...Shall we rest for a bit before heading back?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's true. But it's fine if you forget, you know.
Taking home happy memories as your souvenir is more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute gave a gentle smile.
I couldn't help but admire her mature demeanor.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"That would really help me out...
I'm seriously... at my limit here..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Wonder Acute look so exhausted,
we let her rest in the shade of a tree.
